cases.description: From a clean default-session app-data root, auto-launch managed Firefox and run the core open/snapshot/action/wait/inspect loop.
Open the local fixture and verify both tools land on the same URL/title.
Interactive snapshot emits refs and key fixture controls.
The goto alias follows the open URL contract.
The navigate alias follows the open URL contract.
Capture an input ref from snapshot and fill it.
Capture a button ref from snapshot and click it.
Fill the fixture input using a raw CSS selector.
Click the fixture button using a raw CSS selector.
Wait for a selector to become visible after a click.
Wait a fixed number of milliseconds long enough for delayed fixture text to appear.
Wait for delayed body text using the documented --text wait mode.
Wait for a delayed path URL transition using the documented --url wait mode.
Wait for an element to become hidden using --state hidden.
wait --fn works for DOM-visible predicates but reports the content-script isolated-world limitation.
DOM wait timeouts return the stable pire-browser timeout envelope and exit code.
Default snapshot emits useful flat ref-oriented output without claiming full accessibility-tree parity.
Refs captured from a same-origin iframe are actionable through the core loop.
A ref whose element was removed fails with a stable stale-ref JSON envelope.
A ref whose iframe was removed fails with a stable stale-ref JSON envelope.
Read page title.
Check visible state for a button selector.
Read page title with JSON output to keep the success envelope parseable.
Best-effort commands expose a stable Firefox gap warning in JSON output.
List the current tab.
Type into a selector with keyboard-style events.
Press and key aliases type into the currently focused control.
Enter on a focused text input submits the containing form.
Keyboard type writes into the current focused element.
Keyboard inserttext inserts text into the current focused element.
Find an input by label and fill it.
Find a button by role and accessible name, then click it.
Read text, value, attribute, and URL from the fixture.
Check enabled and checked state helpers.
Create, select, list, and close tabs.
A stale or unknown ref fails with a stable error shape.
A non-unique raw selector fails rather than clicking an arbitrary element.
Unsupported feature returns a stable not-available style failure in pire-browser.
A missing selector fails with a stable JSON error envelope.
A disabled target fails with a stable JSON error envelope instead of reporting a no-op click as success.
An artificially short wait timeout fails with a stable JSON timeout envelope.
Clipboard write and read round-trip text through the Firefox backend.
Clipboard copy captures the current page selection with a Firefox best-effort warning.
Clipboard paste inserts text into the focused editable element with a Firefox best-effort warning.
Clipboard copy without a current selection fails with an actionable JSON error.
Per-command Firefox-impossible global flags are accepted but exposed as JSON warnings.
External visible smoke only: open Bing and then open a Bing results URL.
